title: Notice of extraordinary general meeting
ruleSource: Written from S.A Badmus' Corporate Law drafts (Lawdeck knowledge base). To be confirmed by the legal reviewer, including every section of the Companies and Allied Matters Act 2020 cited.

parts.why: Company documents carry the company's name, registered address and registration (RC) number, and for resolutions and notices the statutory heading. Source: Corporate Law Practice drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).
The title. Source: Corporate Law Practice drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.text:
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that an Extraordinary General Meeting of the above-named company will be held at {{meetingPlace}} on {{meetingDate}} at {{meetingTime}} for the purpose of considering and, if thought fit, passing the following resolution(s) as {{resolutionKind}} resolution(s):
#. {{resolutions}}
parts.why: The venue, date, time, and the resolutions to be considered with their kind (ordinary or special). For re-registration as a public company, the special resolution is 'That, subject to the approval of the Corporate Affairs Commission, the company be re-registered as a public company'. Source: Corporate Law Practice drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.text: NOTE: A member entitled to attend and vote at the meeting is entitled to appoint a proxy to attend and vote instead of him. A proxy need not be a member of the company.
parts.why: The proxy note is compulsory in a notice of a general meeting. Source: Corporate Law Practice drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.text:
Dated this ............ day of ............ 20.....

By Order of the Board of Directors

........................................
{{secretaryName}}
Company Secretary
parts.why: Notices are given by order of the board and signed by the company secretary. Our Ref/Your Ref belong in letters only, not notices or resolutions. Source: Corporate Law Practice drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

fields.label: Company name
fields.question: What is the company's registered name? For example: Gaskiya Nigeria Limited.

fields.label: Date of the meeting
fields.question: When is or was the meeting held?

fields.label: Venue
fields.question: Where is or was the meeting held? For example: the registered office.

fields.label: Resolutions
fields.question: Each resolution to be proposed, one per box.
